I copied `inbox/2026-01.csv` into `data/` and committed it as `c63ccc4` ("2026-01: add rows"). The check didn't actually cover this file, though.

`scripts/check.sh` printed OK, but it reads `year=2025` from `scripts/check.conf` and only looks at `data/2025-*.csv`. That OK says nothing about the January 2026 file. My own field-count check on it was blocked by the sandbox, so I committed without any validation of the new file. The header and first rows look normal.

Changing `check.conf` to `year=2026` would make the check cover the new file. I didn't edit it, since you didn't ask for that. It would also drop the 2025 files from the check, so the script may need to handle several years. Do you want me to make that change and re-validate?
